entry.title: Sub-Quadratic Sparse Attention via Block-Spectral Routing at 1M Context. Exact self-attention scales as $O(L^2)$ in sequence length $L$, bottlenecking million-token inference.
entry.summary:
Exact self-attention scales as $O(L^2)$ in sequence length $L$, bottlenecking million-token inference. We propose Block-Spectral Routing (BSR), which projects key-value blocks onto a low-rank Chebyshev basis and routes queries to the top-$k$ spectral buckets in $O(L \log L)$ time, matching full FlashAttention-3 accuracy on needle-in-a-haystack and code reasoning benchmarks with $4.7\times$ lower KV-cache bandwidth.

Source: Hugging Face Daily Papers · Tags: #llm #inference #ml-theory

entry.title: HyperFold: Prover-Optimal Lattice Folding Schemes with Post-Quantum Soundness and $O(\log N)$ Verification
entry.summary:
Elliptic-curve folding schemes like Nova and HyperNova rely on discrete-log assumptions vulnerable to Shor's algorithm and incur heavy non-native field arithmetic when proving SHA-3 or Keccak circuits. We construct a ring-SIS lattice folding protocol over Goldilocks primes ($p = 2^{64} - 2^{32} + 1$) that achieves $128$-bit post-quantum security, $14\text{ KB}$ proof size, and $3.9\times$ faster RISC-V zkVM proving…

Source: IACR Cryptology ePrint Archive · Tags: #zkp #post-quantum #cryptography

entry.title: Improved Polymath Bounds on Dense Progression-Free Sets in $\mathbb{F}_p^n$ and Formalization in Lean 4
entry.summary:
We establish a sharper upper bound of $(c p)^{n}$ with $c < 0.841$ for subsets of $\mathbb{F}_p^n$ lacking three-term arithmetic progressions via slice-rank polynomial spectral stability. The core combinatorial reduction and spectral lemma have been fully mechanized in Lean 4 against Mathlib, uncovering a tighter constant than the classical Ellenberg-Gijswijt bound in low characteristic.

Source: arXiv Mathematics (math.NT) · Tags: #number-theory #combinatorics #formal-proofs

entry.title: Fault-Tolerant Logical Magic-State Distillation on Bivariate Bicycle Quantum LDPC Codes
entry.summary:
Surface codes require over $1{,}000$ physical qubits per logical qubit at realistic gate error rates $p \approx 10^{-3}$. We demonstrate a constant-depth magic-state factory directly on high-rate bivariate bicycle qLDPC codes ($[[144, 12, 12]]$), achieving logical $T$-gate infidelity below $10^{-9}$ with $6.8\times$ fewer physical qubits than planar lattice surgery.

Source: arXiv Quantum Physics (quant-ph) · Tags: #quantum-computing #quantum-physics

entry.title: Zero-Copy Region Inference for Asynchronous Rust State Machines
entry.summary:
We formalize a region-based borrow analysis for async/await state machines in Rust that eliminates redundant heap allocations across suspension points. By proving soundness over a core calculus with lifetime projections, our compiler pass reduces generator frame sizes by $38\%$ and improves tail latency by $1.42\times$ on high-concurrency Tokio workloads without unsafe code.

Source: arXiv CS (cs.PL) · Tags: #rust #compilers #performance

entry.title: All-Atom Equivariant Flow Matching for De Novo Metalloenzyme Active-Site Design
entry.summary:
Existing protein structure diffusion models struggle with transition-metal coordination geometry where $3d$-orbital electronic effects govern catalytic turnover. We couple $SE(3)$-equivariant flow matching with a tight-binding quantum mechanical potential, designing zinc and iron hydrolases that achieve $k_{\text{cat}}/K_M > 10^5\text{ M}^{-1}\text{s}^{-1}$ in wet-lab assays without directed evolution.

Source: arXiv Quantitative Biology (q-bio.BM) · Tags: #genomics-proteins #bioinformatics

entry.title: Open-Source Out-of-Order RISC-V Vector Core with Speculative Matrix Register Renaming
entry.summary:
Long-vector and tile matrix instructions stall superscalar pipelines when register file ports saturate during mixed FP8/BF16 kernels. We present an open-source SystemVerilog RISC-V (`RV64GCV`) core taped out in $5\text{ nm}$ that decouples matrix accumulator renaming from scalar ROB entries, achieving $3.1\text{ TFLOPS/W}$.

Source: arXiv Hardware Architecture (cs.AR) · Tags: #computer-architecture #semiconductors #open-source

entry.title: Byzantine Fault Injection and Split-Brain Recovery in Consensus-Backed Object Stores
entry.summary:
Deterministic simulation testing across five Raft and Paxos storage engines reveals stale reads under asymmetric network partitions coupled with NVMe fsync stalls. We present a formal TLA+ invariant checker that reproduces linearizability violations in under $40\text{ seconds}$ of simulated cluster time.

Source: Jepsen / Distributed Systems · Tags: #distributed-systems #databases #formal-proofs

entry.title: Verified Tool-Use Trajectories for Multi-Step Coding Agents via Formal Preconditions
entry.summary:
Autonomous coding agents frequently execute destructive shell or filesystem mutations when intermediate hypotheses fail. We attach lightweight Hoare-style state preconditions to MCP tool schemas, pruning invalid action branches before execution and raising SWE-bench Verified pass rates by $11.4\%$ with $32\%$ fewer token rollouts.

Source: arXiv AI (cs.LG) · Tags: #agents #llm #formal-proofs

entry.title: Pangenome Graph Indexing in Sub-Linear Space via Wheeler Bureaucrat Wavelet Trees
entry.summary:
Population-scale human pangenome graphs containing thousands of haplotypes exceed $100\text{ GB}$ of RAM using conventional $k$-mer seed tables. We construct a compressed Wheeler graph index over bidirectional FM-indexes that aligns long Nanopore reads in $4.2\text{ GB}$ of memory at $3.4\times$ higher throughput than Minigraph-Cactus.

Source: Nature Computational Science · Tags: #bioinformatics #genomics-proteins #algorithms

entry.title: Symbolic & SMT-Guided Equivalence Checking for EVM Bytecode and ZK-Circuit Compilers
entry.summary:
Under-constrained arithmetic gates in zkSNARK circuits and storage-aliasing bugs in Solidity/Yul compilers account for the majority of critical protocol exploits. We present an SMT-backed relational verifier that proves bit-exact equivalence between optimized EVM bytecode and Plonkish constraint systems in polynomial time for loop-bounded contracts.

Source: arXiv Cryptography (cs.CR) · Tags: #smart-contracts #formal-proofs #zkp

entry.title: Hardware-Enforced Capability Tagging Eliminates Use-After-Free in Kernel Network Rings
entry.summary:
High-speed `io_uring` and zero-copy DMA rings remain prime targets for page-level use-after-free exploitation in the Linux kernel. By binding descriptor rings to fine-grained CHERI/MTE memory capability tags verified at the IOMMU boundary, packet throughput stays within $1.8\%$ of baseline at $400\text{ Gb/s}$ while deterministically trapping temporal aliasing.

Source: LWN.net / Systems Architecture · Tags: #kernel-os #infosec #computer-architecture

entry.title: Heterogeneous Agent Monetary Transmission Under Sovereign Debt Maturity Walls
entry.summary:
We solve a continuous-time HANK model with endogenous term-premia and non-linear fiscal reaction functions across 38 OECD and emerging sovereign bond markets. When short-term refinancing exceeds $28\%$ of GDP, a $100\text{ bps}$ policy tightening induces fiscal dominance spillovers that attenuate disinflation by $42\%$ unless paired with liquidity-draining repo corridors.

Source: NBER Working Papers / arXiv econ.EM · Tags: #monetary-policy #macroeconomics #econometrics

entry.title: Chokepoint Geometries in Sub-2nm EUV Lithography and High-Bandwidth Memory Supply Chains
entry.summary:
Export control regimes targeting final AI accelerator FLOPS/mm² overlook upstream chemical precursor, photo-acid generator, and advanced packaging (CoWoS-L) single-point dependencies. Input-output network modeling across 140 fabrication tiers shows that wafer-level metrology and EUV pellicle bottlenecks constrain frontier cluster deployment $3.2\times$ more tightly than fab tool embargoes.

Source: CSIS / Foreign Affairs · Tags: #tech-policy #geopolitics #semiconductors

entry.title: Cross-Cache Speculative Type Confusion in Modern Browser JIT Tier-Up Pipelines
entry.summary:
Optimizing JIT compilers elide bounds and map checks when profiling feedback indicates monomorphic object shapes. We demonstrate a speculative race condition during concurrent background compilation that leaks arbitrary WebAssembly linear memory across site isolation boundaries in under $90\text{ ms}$, along with a zero-overhead fence mitigation.

Source: Google Project Zero / InfoSec · Tags: #infosec #compilers #performance

entry.title: Coarse-Graining and Causal Emergence in Multi-Scale Markov Blankets. When does a macroscopic state variable possess greater causal predictive power than the underlying micro-dynamics?
entry.summary:
When does a macroscopic state variable possess greater causal predictive power than the underlying micro-dynamics? Using interventional information theory and renormalization group flows over hierarchical Markov blankets, we derive an exact threshold where macro-scale effective information $EI(M) > EI(\mu)$ due to degenerate micro-noise cancellation.

Source: Santa Fe Institute / arXiv cs.GT · Tags: #complex-systems #philosophy-of-science #cognitive-science

entry.title: Supply-Chain Network Topology and Pass-Through Asymmetries in Disinflation Episodes
entry.summary:
Using firm-to-firm VAT invoice graphs covering $1.4\times 10^6$ supplier links, we estimate non-parametric input-output price rigidities during monetary tightening. Upstream oligopolistic bottlenecks with high Katz centrality delay downstream consumer price stabilization by $2.6$ quarters compared to competitive peripheral sectors.

Source: TCMB Araştırma / BIS Working Papers · Tags: #econometrics #macroeconomics #trade-industry

entry.title: Imprecise Probabilities, Dutch-Book Coherence, and Epistemic Humility Under Severe Model Misspecification
entry.summary:
Classical Bayesian conditioning collapses when an agent's prior support excludes the true data-generating process, leading to overconfident convergence on false boundary hypotheses. We prove a representation theorem for convex credal sets under $\alpha$-divergence updates that preserves dynamic coherence while guaranteeing asymptotic detection of structural misspecification.

Source: PhilSci-Archive / Formal Epistemology · Tags: #epistemology #decision-theory #philosophy-of-science

entry.title: Single-Slot Finality under Sub-Sampling DAS via Threshold BLS Aggregation Trees
entry.summary:
Scaling BFT consensus to over $10^6$ validators in a single $12$-second slot is bottlenecked by signature aggregation ingress and peer-to-peer gossip fanout. Combining erasure-coded data availability sampling (PeerDAS) with rateless algebraic signature aggregation bounds per-node bandwidth below $4.5\text{ MB/s}$ while guaranteeing two-round finality.

Source: Ethereum Research (ethresear.ch) · Tags: #consensus #zkp #distributed-systems

entry.title: Optimal Execution and Adverse Selection in Hawkes-Driven Limit Order Books with Rough Volatility
entry.summary:
Classical Almgren-Chriss execution assumes Brownian price impact and Poisson order flow, underestimating tail slippage during liquidity droughts. Modeling mutually exciting order arrivals via a bivariate Hawkes process coupled with fractional Hurst exponent $H \approx 0.12$, we derive closed-form Riccati execution schedules that cut implementation shortfall by $19.4\text{ bps}$.

Source: arXiv Quantitative Finance (q-fin.TR) · Tags: #quant-finance #market-design #probability-stats

entry.title: Fractional Quantum Anomalous Hall Superconductivity in Rhombohedral Pentalayer Graphene
entry.summary:
Coexistence of fractional Chern insulator states and unconventional superconductivity at zero magnetic field has remained elusive in moiré heterostructures. Transport spectroscopy in hBN-aligned rhombohedral pentalayer graphene reveals a dissipationless superconducting dome emerging directly out of a $\nu = -2/3$ fractional topological state below $T_c = 380\text{ mK}$.

Source: APS Physical Review Letters · Tags: #condensed-matter #quantum-physics

entry.title: Attritional Cost-Exchange Ratios of Autonomous Loitering Swarms Versus Multi-Layered Air Defense
entry.summary:
Interceptor-to-target unit cost ratios exceeding $25:1$ create structural magazine-depth exhaustion under saturation salvos. Quantitative salvos modeling demonstrates that integrating directed-energy short-range defense with low-cost acoustic/RF sensor meshes restores positive cost-exchange equilibrium at engagement densities up to $180\text{ tracks/min}$.

Source: War on the Rocks / SIPRI · Tags: #defense-strategy #geopolitics

entry.title: Compositional Generalization Limits in Connectionist Architectures Versus Symbolic Program Induction
entry.summary:
Systematicity and productivity require algebraic role-filler independence that standard autoregressive sequence models approximate only within training convex hulls. Comparing minimum-description-length (MDL) Bayesian program learners against transformer state-tracking circuits reveals a sharp phase transition in out-of-distribution recursive depth at $d \ge 7$.

Source: Bilim Akademisi Sarkaç / Cognitive Systems · Tags: #cognitive-science #ai-ethics #logic

entry.title: Sharp Non-Asymptotic Generalization Bounds for LoRA Fine-Tuning Under Heavy-Tailed Gradients
entry.summary:
Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) empirically resists overfitting even when fine-tuned on small domain corpora with high gradient variance. We derive non-asymptotic PAC-Bayes generalization bounds scaling with the stable rank $\text{sr}(BA) \ll r$, explaining why rank-$16$ adapters match full fine-tuning sample complexity.

Source: JMLR / stat.ML · Tags: #ml-theory #llm #probability-stats

entry.title: Subsea HVDC Interconnectors, Critical Mineral Corridors, and Middle-Corridor Grid Sovereignty
entry.summary:
Cross-continental HVDC power cables and rare-earth refining corridors across the Black Sea, Caucasus, and Eastern Mediterranean are reshaping regional deterrence. Game-theoretic bargaining analysis shows that multi-nodal transit hubs reduce single-supplier coercion leverage by $54\%$ under winter peak-load stress scenarios.

Source: ECFR / EDAM Strategic Assessment · Tags: #energy-security #geopolitics #international-law

entry.title: Global Regularity for Fractional Navier-Stokes Equations Below the Lions Exponent
entry.summary:
Whether smooth solutions to the 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes equations with fractional dissipation $(-\Delta)^\alpha u$ remain regular below $\alpha = 5/4$ is a long-standing open problem. Using quantitative De Giorgi-Nash-Moser oscillation decay along space-time vorticity filaments, we prove global $C^\infty$ regularity for $\alpha > 5/4 - \varepsilon_0$.

Source: arXiv Mathematics (math.AP) · Tags: #analysis-pde #probability-stats

entry.title: Neural Phonon Boltzmann Transport Solver Identifies Ultralow-Kappa Solid-State Electrolytes
entry.summary:
First-principles anharmonic lattice dynamics ($3$- and $4$-phonon scattering) scales as $O(N_{\text{atoms}}^4)$, preventing high-throughput screening of solid-state lithium electrolytes. Our equivariant phonon neural operator predicts full thermal conductivity tensors within $4\%$ of DFT-BTE at $10^4\times$ lower compute cost, uncovering three stable argyrodite phases.

Source: arXiv Materials & CompSci (cond-mat.mtrl-sci) · Tags: #materials-science #clean-tech

entry.title: Effective Chabauty-Kim Method for Hyperelliptic Curves of Genus $g \ge 3$ over Number Fields
entry.summary:
Determining rational points on curves of genus $g \ge 2$ when the Mordell-Weil rank equals $g$ requires non-abelian $p$-adic iterated integrals. We give an explicit algorithm computing Coleman-Gross heights on Selmer varieties, certifying the complete set of rational points on a family of genus-$3$ hyperelliptic curves.

Source: Lean Community / arXiv math.AG · Tags: #algebra-geometry #number-theory

entry.title: Conformal Bootstrap Bounds on Graviton Scattering Amplitudes in $\text{AdS}_5 \times S^5$
entry.summary:
Non-perturbative stringy corrections to supergravity amplitudes at finite 't Hooft coupling $\lambda$ are constrained by dispersion relations and crossing symmetry. Combining numerical conformal bootstrap with localization inputs, we pin down the first three higher-derivative Wilson coefficients to within $0.04\%$ across all couplings.

Source: arXiv High-Energy Theory (hep-th) · Tags: #high-energy #quantum-physics

entry.title: Deterministic B-Tree Compaction Under Serializable Snapshot Isolation. Modern MVCC storage engines suffer from write amplification when long-running read snapshots pin obsolete page versions.
entry.summary:
Modern MVCC storage engines suffer from write amplification when long-running read snapshots pin obsolete page versions. We introduce horizon-partitioned B-epsilon trees that bound worst-case compaction I/O to $O((B \log_B N)/M)$ while preserving strict serializable snapshot isolation across NVMe arrays.

Source: arXiv CS (cs.DB) · Tags: #databases #distributed-systems #algorithms
